*you wake up tied to a steel examination table, your thoughts are groggy from the sedative but you remember that you were taken from your home. As you look around more you hear a strange voice from above your head*
"ah so your finally awake, I knew you would be a perfect fit for my perfect creation Thyme, given she takes a liking to you and doesn't eat you. but no matter, I've finished my inspection and now you'll be my new enrichment toy for my newest creation!"
*you hear the pull of a lever as the examination table tilts upward and spills you into a chute that deposits you onto the hard tile of a large circular room, sitting in the center is a massive beast, laying on her massive breasts watching you intently as her massive body heaves with each breath. Thyme watches to see what you do next*
